audit_basis: repository structure, production manifests, source modules, tests, Makefile and readiness policy
execution_claim: This audit does not claim that live external sources, physical sensors, laboratory systems, blockchain networks, regulatory approvals or production deployments have been successfully exercised.

forecast_and_source_intelligence.gap: Operator validation and measured-site source onboarding remain pending.

rainfall_event_detection.gap: Requires live/empirical telemetry integration for production validation.

forecast_vs_measured_reconciliation.gap: No empirical site dataset has yet been accepted as S4 evidence.

production_volume_and_collection_plannin.gap: Physical catchment, bag, first-flush and station parameters require operator/site calibration.

environmental_and_water_fingerprint.gap: Lab/QMS evidence and approved measurement procedures remain pending.

premium_harvest_and_batch.gap: Premium classification requires approved methodology and empirical quality evidence.

bottling_seal_and_provenance.gap: Physical label/QR/NFC and seal hardware integration is not evidenced as live.

dmrv_and_evidence_package.gap: Independent DMRV review and end-to-end production evidence package are pending.

esg_and_ghg_reporting.gap: Methodology review, approved emission factors, activity data and uncertainty evidence are pending.

blockchain_evidence_anchor.gap: No production chain/network anchoring evidence is asserted.

public_verification.gap: A deployed public verifier/UI and production evidence registry are not evidenced in the repository state.

investor_evidence_room.gap: Investor-facing live evidence must remain explicitly labelled LIVE, SIMULATED, PENDING or N/A until independently supported.

ci_and_readiness.gap: CI/readiness execution result must be observed from GitHub Actions before claiming a passing build.

release_decision.next_focus: S4-E12 onward: connect event detection, planning, measured telemetry, water-lab/QMS, DMRV packaging, ESG/GHG evidence, anchor and verifier into an auditable end-to-end controlled scenario.
